name: Arcane Bolt
description: A quick burst of raw arcane energy. Deals minor magic damage instantly.
cast_messages: {name} flicks a bolt of arcane energy!
{name} flicks a bolt of arcane energy!
{name} flicks a bolt of arcane energy!
{name} releases an arcane bolt!

name: Magic Missile
description: A seeker-bolt of pure magic. Deals magic damage and never misses.
cast_messages: {name} begins forming a seeker-missile...
{name} continues forming a seeker-missile...
{name} locks onto the target!
A magic missile streaks toward its mark!

name: Frost Bolt
description: A bolt of ice that damages and applies Slow for 2 ticks.
cast_messages: {name} inhales sharply, frost forming on their lips.
{name} draws icy energy into their hands.
{name} takes aim with a crackling bolt of ice!
A shard of frost streaks through the air!

name: Fireball
description: Calls down a sphere of fire engulfing a 2x2 section of the battlefield.
cast_messages: {name} begins tracing a sigil in the air.
{name} breathes deeply, heat shimmering around their hands.
{name} screams the word of ignition!
A fireball detonates across the battlefield!

name: Chain Lightning
description: Lightning arcs between all enemies dealing lightning damage.
cast_messages: {name} raises a hand, static crackling in the air.
{name} calls the storm down...
{name} extends both arms, lightning dancing between their fingers!
Chain lightning arcs across the battlefield!

name: Arcane Shield
description: Absorbs the next hit taken for 4 ticks.
cast_messages: {name} begins weaving a protective barrier.
{name} continues weaving a protective barrier.
{name} completes the barrier runes!
An arcane shield shimmers around {name}!

name: Blink
description: Teleports a short distance, granting 50% dodge chance on the next attack.
cast_messages: {name} blinks!
{name} blinks!
{name} blinks!
{name} blinks in a flash of light!

name: Arcane Light
description: Suffuses the area with magical radiance.

name: Identify
description: Reveal the full stats of an unidentified item.
